title: The Firm
description: A law-school grad uncovers a sinister secret about the Tennessee firm that made him an offer he couldn't refuse.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
description: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.

title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
description: The owner (Vince Vaughn) of a gym and an overbearing entrepreneur (Ben Stiller) form dodgeball teams to compete for $50,000 in Las Vegas.

title: My Cousin Vinny
description: Two New Yorkers accused of murder in rural Alabama while on their way back to college call in the help of one of their cousins, a loudmouth lawyer with no trial experience.

title: Argo
description: During the Iran hostage crisis, an extraction specialist (Ben Affleck) in the CIA poses as a Hollywood film producer to rescue six Americans who eluded Iranian militants and found refuge with the Canadian ambassador.

title: The Death of Stalin
description: When dictator Joseph Stalin dies, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government?

title: Se7en
description: A meticulous detective and the young officer about to replace the veteran probe serial murders based on the seven deadly sins.

title: Gone Baby Gone
description: Two private investigators (Casey Affleck, Michelle Monaghan) tread dangerous ground as they scour the Boston underworld for a kidnapped child.

title: The Running Man
description: A police-state scapegoat (Arnold Schwarzenegger) must play a TV host's (Richard Dawson) deadly game show for the 21st-century masses.

title: Scary Movie V
description: Bizarre activity follows after a husband and wife bring their newborn baby home from the hospital. Realizing that a demon is stalking their family, they consult paranormal experts and install numerous cameras to drive the spirit out.

title: The Aviator
description: During the 1930s and '40s, wealthy industrialist Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) gains fame as a movie producer, airplane designer and pilot.

title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
description: Globe-trotting archaeologist Indiana Jones races the Nazis for possession of a legendary religious artifact.

title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
description: In 1935 archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford), a lounge singer (Kate Capshaw) and a Chinese orphan (Ke Huy Quan) search for mystical stones stolen from an Indian tribe.

title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
description: Archaeologist Jones (Harrison Ford) rescues his kidnapped father (Sean Connery), and the two race the Nazis to find the Holy Grail.

title: Machete Kills
description: The president recruits ex-Federale Machete to take down an eccentric arms dealer who plans to spread war and anarchy throughout the world.

title: Patriot Games
description: An IRA terrorist vows revenge against the ex-CIA agent who killed the man's brother and thwarted an attack on royalty.

title: Dunkirk
description: Germany advances into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops are slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every vessel that can be found.

title: Homestead
description: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos.

title: Blindness
description: A doctor's wife is one of the few individuals immune to a strange epidemic that causes people to lose their eyesight.

title: The Spell
description: A dark spirit's quest for vengeance shatters a young couple's lives soon after they move into their new home.

title: Wes Craven Presents: They
description: A psychology student (Laura Regan) and her friends begin to have nightmares, resulting in strange marks appearing on their bodies.

title: Aeon Flux
description: In the last city on Earth, underground rebels dispatch their top assassin (Charlize Theron) to kill a government leader.

title: Lara Croft: Tomb Raider
description: A beautiful globe-trotter (Angelina Jolie) battles otherworldly creatures for possession of a powerful artifact.

title: The Perfect Gamble
description: Released from prison, two gamblers get entangled with the mafia when they decide to open an illegal casino.

title: The Score
description: A master thief (Robert De Niro) agrees to work with a volatile partner (Edward Norton) for one last heist before he retires.
Sparta's King Leonidas (Gerard Butler) and his badly outnumbered warriors fight to the death against King Xerxes' massive Persian army at the Battle of Thermopylae.

title: Get Hard
description: The prison-bound manager of a hedge fund asks a Black businessman, who has never been to jail, to prepare him for life behind bars.

title: Gravity
description: The destruction of their shuttle leaves two astronauts, Dr. Ryan Stone and Matt Kowalski, stranded in space with no hope of rescue.

title: Gladiator
description: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.
Sparta's King Leonidas (Gerard Butler) and his badly outnumbered warriors fight to the death against King Xerxes' massive Persian army at the Battle of Thermopylae.

title: 300: Rise of an Empire
description: Xerxes, driven by vengeance for his father's death, leads an army against Greece; Greek city-states join forces under Athens' command to fight Artemisia in a naval battle.

title: The Hangover
description: After a wild stag party in Las Vegas, three hazy groomsmen (Bradley Cooper, Ed Helms, Zach Galifianakis) must find their missing friend and get him back to Los Angeles in time for his wedding.

title: The Hangover Part II
description: Hoping to avoid the mayhem that marked his friend's Las Vegas bachelor party, Stu opts for what he thinks will be a safe prewedding brunch in Thailand.

title: The Hangover Part III
description: Phil, Stu and Doug take Alan on a road trip to help him through a personal crisis. Mr. Chow breaks out of prison and prepares to wreak havoc.

title: Congo
description: Killer gorillas menace an ex-CIA agent (Laura Linney), a primatologist (Dylan Walsh) and others on a mission in Africa.

title: Daniela Forever
description: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams.

title: Vanilla Sky
description: A wealthy womanizer (Tom Cruise) has trouble distinguishing dreams from reality after a car accident leaves him disfigured.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
description: A soldier fighting aliens gets to relive the same day over and over again, the day restarting every time he dies.

title: Sweetness
description: When a fan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him.

title: Terminator: Dark Fate
description: Seasoned warrior Sarah Connor joins forces with a hybrid cyborg human and the T-800 model to protect a young woman from the Rev-9 -- a newly modified and seemingly indestructible liquid Terminator from the future.

title: Blade Runner 2049
description: After discovering a long-buried secret that jeopardizes what's left of society, a new Blade Runner embarks on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

title: Kiss the Girls
description: After escaping from a serial killer, a doctor (Ashley Judd) helps police and a forensic psychologist (Morgan Freeman) track the madman.
